elections.note: Annulled by the Constitutional Court; main opposition parties boycotted

source.name: Wikipedia, citing Psephos and Thai Rath

elections.notes: Votes and shares are the party-list vote; seats are the total of constituency and party-list seats. Shares are of the table's vote total, which counts 9,051,706 blank votes as valid; they are kept as their own row so shares add up. No seat-change column. Turnout is the infobox's figure. The Democrat, Thai Nation and Mahachon parties boycotted the election, and many voters used the abstain option, recorded here as None of the above (the table's "Blank votes"). The Constitutional Court invalidated the result and the new election set for October 2006 was cancelled by the coup. The table's "Vacant seats" row (39 constituency seats left unfilled; the lead says TRT candidates in a number of southern seats failed to reach the required 20% of registered voters) is kept as Vacant. Thai Rak Thai won 461 seats; no winner is flagged because the election was annulled.
